Chocolate Lip Balm Spa
By: Adam Paul Green
Published: Monday, July 23, 2012 - 11:57am

Ingredients




3 tbsps cocoa butter
1 chunk dark chocolate (Xocai X Power Square, broken up)
1 whole vitamin e (vitamin E capsule)
1/4 tsp almond extract (or olive oil)
1 whole vitamins (1 MSM 1000 capsule (optional))

Preparation

1 Put cocoa butte in small microwave-safe dish. Melt in microwave. Add broken up X Power Square, and stir until melted. Add vitamin E, almond extract or olive oil, and optional MSM 1000 (great for skin). Stir until completely mixed. Let cool. Keep in an airtight container. Use on lips. Serves 1
